    lin_expr += 6.25 * vars['Var_3']

    m.addConstr(9.01 * vars['Var_0'] + 9.24 * vars['Var_1'] + 9.21 * vars['Var_2'] + 4.7 * vars['Var_4'] + 6.04 * vars['Var_6'] + 4.81 * vars['Var_7'] <= 159.21, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(1.98 * vars['Var_1'] + 1.09 * vars['Var_2'] + 6.85 * vars['Var_3'] + 3.75 * vars['Var_6'] + 5.01 * vars['Var_7'] <= 70.24, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(0.39 * vars['Var_3'] + 8.73 * vars['Var_4'] + 1.12 * vars['Var_5'] + 2.43 * vars['Var_7'] <= 17.44, name='C6')
    m.addConstr(0.62 * vars['Var_0'] + 7.6 * vars['Var_1'] + 7.51 * vars['Var_3'] + 5.93 * vars['Var_6'] + 0.33 * vars['Var_7'] <= 79.78, name='C7')
